name: SULFUROUS AMOEBA
description: A wiggling blob of acidic gelly.
motives_and_tactics: Block tunnels, produce sulfur, desolve creatures

features.name: Acidic Form
features.description: When the Amoeba makes a successful attack, the target must mark an Armor Slot without receiving its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage). If they can’t mark an Armor Slot, they must mark an additional HP.

features.name: Out of Nowhere
features.description: The Assassin has advantage on attacks if they are Hidden.

features.name: Fumigation
features.description: Drop a smoke bomb that fills the air within Close range with smoke, *Dizzying* all targets in this area. *Dizzied* targets have disadvantage on their next action roll, then clear the condition.
